```python
import polars as pl

# Create a DataFrame with duplicate rows
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "id": [1, 2, 2, 3, 1, 4],
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Bob", "Charlie", "Alice", "David"],
    "age": [25, 30, 30, 35, 25, 40]
})

# Remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence
df_unique = df.unique(keep="first")

print(df_unique)
```
